snippet.title: Path of Gear: Blacksmith's Legend PV3 – Demo on Steam Aug 2025
snippet.description:
🔥 PATH OF GEAR: BLACKSMITH'S LEGEND – Official PV3 🔥

A roguelite adventure that combines combat, exploration, and weapon forging! 🛠️⚔️

💎 Key Features:
🔹 Procedurally Generated Maps – No two adventures are the same! Every run brings new challenges.
🔹 Timeline-Based Combat – Predict enemy actions and carefully time your attacks to gain the upper hand.
🔹 Deep Weapon Forging – Craft your own arsenal with 28 materials and 100+ unique weapon combinations. Build the ultimate weapon deck!

⚔️ Are you ready to become a legendary blacksmith?
🧪 Demo coming to Steam in August 2025!
✨ Add to your Steam Wishlist now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3082000/_/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=PV3
